symptom: Task stops with stoppedReason 'CannotPullContainerError: pull access denied for <repo>, repository does not exist or may require authorization'. Image is in private ECR (or Docker Hub private repo) and authn is missing.

diagnostic_steps.command: docker pull <image> from a non-authn'd shell

diagnostic_steps.action: For ECR: check executionRoleArn has ecr:GetAuthorizationToken + ecr:BatchGetImage + ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
For non-ECR private: check repositoryCredentials field on task-def

fix_steps.action: ECR: attach AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly policy (or specific perms) to executionRoleArn
fix_steps.command: aws iam attach-role-policy --role-name <execRole> --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEC2ContainerRegistryReadOnly

fix_steps.action: Non-ECR: create Secrets Manager secret with {username,password}; reference in repositoryCredentials.credentialsParameter
fix_steps.command: aws secretsmanager create-secret --name registry-creds --secret-string '{"username":"u","password":"p"}'; update task def with that ARN; register new revision
fix_steps.rollback: Make repo public OR pre-pull image to ECR

symptom: stoppedReason 'CannotPullContainerError: net/http: TLS handshake timeout' or 'no such host'. Task subnet has no path to the registry.

diagnostic_steps.action: Identify task subnet + check internet egress
diagnostic_steps.expected: Route to NAT/IGW for ECR public OR VPC endpoint for ECR

diagnostic_steps.action: If using VPC endpoints, confirm com.amazonaws.<region>.ecr.api + com.amazonaws.<region>.ecr.dkr + com.amazonaws.<region>.s3 endpoints exist + SG allows

fix_steps.action: Add NAT for the private subnet OR enable assignPublicIp=ENABLED
fix_steps.command: Update subnet route to NAT gateway, OR run-task --network-configuration '...,assignPublicIp=ENABLED'

fix_steps.action: Or create the ECR + S3 VPC endpoints (private connectivity, no egress cost)
fix_steps.command: aws ec2 create-vpc-endpoint --vpc-id <vpc> --service-name com.amazonaws.<region>.ecr.api --vpc-endpoint-type Interface ...; same for ecr.dkr; for S3 use Gateway endpoint type

symptom: stoppedReason 'CannotPullContainerError: toomanyrequests: You have reached your pull rate limit. You may increase the limit by authenticating'.  Anonymous Docker Hub pull rate limit hit.

diagnostic_steps.action: Confirm image is from docker.io anonymously

fix_steps.action: Mirror image to ECR (recommended for production)
fix_steps.command: aws ecr create-repository --repository-name mirror/<image>; docker pull <image>; docker tag ... ; docker push <ECR-URI>; update task def to use ECR URI
fix_steps.validation: Pulls from ECR; no Docker Hub rate limit

fix_steps.action: Or authenticate to Docker Hub (raises rate limit)
fix_steps.command: Set ECS_ENGINE_AUTH_DATA on instance OR use repositoryCredentials with Secrets Manager

symptom: Task fails with stoppedReason 'ResourceInitializationError: unable to pull secrets or registry auth: ... AccessDeniedException'. Execution role can't fetch from Secrets Manager / SSM.

diagnostic_steps.command: Look at task def container 'secrets' field; cross-reference stoppedReason for the specific ARN that failed
aws sts assume-role --role-arn <execRole> --role-session-name test; with creds: aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id <arn>

fix_steps.action: Add secretsmanager:GetSecretValue (or ssm:GetParameters) + kms:Decrypt (if KMS-encrypted) to executionRoleArn
fix_steps.command: aws iam put-role-policy --role-name <execRole> --policy-name fetch-secrets --policy-document '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["secretsmanager:GetSecretValue","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["<secret-arn>","<kms-arn>"]}]}'

symptom: Task fails with stoppedReason 'ResourceInitializationError: failed to setup task network: ... ENI attach timeout'. Subnet IP exhaustion or ENI quota hit.

fix_steps.action: Add more/larger subnets to networkConfiguration.subnets[]
fix_steps.command: Update service definition to spread tasks across more AZs/subnets

fix_steps.action: Enable ENI trunking (HDE)
fix_steps.command: aws ecs put-account-setting --name awsvpcTrunking --value enabled; ECS_ENABLE_HIGH_DENSITY_ENI=true on agent (default true)

fix_steps.action: Request quota increase
fix_steps.command: aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code vpc --quota-code L-DF5E4CA3 --desired-value <N>

symptom: RunTask fails synchronously with failures[].reason 'RESOURCE:CPU' or 'RESOURCE:MEMORY' — no instance has enough free capacity.

diagnostic_steps.command: aws ecs describe-container-instances --cluster <c> --container-instances $(aws ecs list-container-instances --cluster <c> --query 'containerInstanceArns' --output text) --query 'containerInstances[].remainingResources'
diagnostic_steps.expected: Sum of CPU/MEMORY across instances should fit the task
Should fit on at least one instance

fix_steps.action: Add capacity (scale ASG up, add instance, or use Fargate)
fix_steps.command: Increase ASG desiredCapacity OR run-task --launch-type FARGATE

fix_steps.action: Reduce task resource requests if over-provisioned
fix_steps.command: Lower task-level cpu/memory; register new revision

symptom: Placement fails with reason 'ATTRIBUTE:ecs.<x>'. No instance matches the task's placementConstraints expression.

diagnostic_steps.expected: Confirm the constraint matches at least some instances

fix_steps.action: Loosen constraint OR add instances matching it
fix_steps.command: Update placement constraint expression; OR launch instances with the right attribute (via PutAttributes API or ECS_INSTANCE_ATTRIBUTES env var)

symptom: Task stops with stoppedReason 'Essential container in task exited' and container exitCode != 0. App crashed; ECS terminated the whole task.

diagnostic_steps.expected: exitCode + reason for the essential container

fix_steps.action: Fix the app and deploy a new task-def revision
fix_steps.command: Build → push → register-task-def → update-service
fix_steps.rollback: Roll back to previous revision via update-service --task-definition <family>:<old-revision>

fix_steps.action: If crash is transient/non-deterministic, set deploymentCircuitBreaker.enable+rollback to auto-rollback failed deployments
fix_steps.command: Update service deploymentConfiguration

symptom: Task stops with stoppedReason 'OutOfMemoryError: Container killed due to memory usage'. Container hit its hard memory limit.

diagnostic_steps.expected: Compare to actual usage from CloudWatch /aws/ecs/containerinsights/<cluster>/performance

diagnostic_steps.action: Inspect dmesg on container instance for OOM kill
diagnostic_steps.command: ssh ec2-user@<instance>; sudo dmesg | grep -i 'killed process'
diagnostic_steps.expected: OOM kill of the container's main process

fix_steps.action: Raise container memory hard limit
fix_steps.command: Update task-def container.memory; register new revision; update service
fix_steps.validation: No more OOM kills under normal load

fix_steps.action: Investigate memory leak in app
fix_steps.command: Run with profiler / heap dump; fix leaks

symptom: ELB-fronted service constantly killing tasks. Service event: 'service X has stopped Y running tasks: Task failed ELB health checks'. Tasks are healthy app-internally but slow to start.

diagnostic_steps.command: Look at first-successful-LB-check time post task start in app logs

fix_steps.action: Raise healthCheckGracePeriodSeconds on the service
fix_steps.command: aws ecs update-service --cluster <c> --service <s> --health-check-grace-period-seconds 300

fix_steps.action: Also set container.healthCheck.startPeriod
fix_steps.command: Add startPeriod to the task-def healthCheck
fix_steps.validation: Container HC failures during startup don't count

symptom: Deployment fails; service event: 'service X is unable to consistently start tasks successfully'. Circuit breaker tripped after multiple task failures; rolled back automatically.

diagnostic_steps.action: Find the failing tasks from the failed deployment
diagnostic_steps.command: aws ecs list-tasks --cluster <c> --desired-status STOPPED --family <family>; describe each

fix_steps.action: Diagnose root cause from common stoppedReason (likely one of the other failure modes here)
fix_steps.command: Cross-reference with this catalog by stoppedReason pattern

fix_steps.action: Once fixed, register new revision + update service; circuit breaker auto-resets
fix_steps.command: Standard CI/CD flow
fix_steps.rollback: Service is already on prior good revision (auto-rollback)
